profile.headline: Software Engineer - Sr. Consultant at Visa
profile.summary:
Sr. Software Engineer @Visa.  Passionate about learning new technologies and industry trends to develop my skills. I am very quick learner and committed to achieving results.  

I hold a Master of Computer Science degree in Computer Science. With three years of experience working as Software Developer, My technical proficiency includes working knowledge of different programming languages, software development methodologies and object-oriented programming. 

Skills:
Programing Languages/Frameworks: Java (J2EE, JSP, Servlets, and Log4j), HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, Web Services (REST API), Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, AWS, Rabbit MQ, Swagger, JSON, Objective-C, C++, Python, Shell Script, Cucumber
Database:  MySQL, Oracle, Cassandra, MongoDB, and SQLite
Test Frameworks: Junit, Behavior Driven Framework (BDD)
Version Control: Git and Clearcase
Development IDE’s /Dev Tools: Eclipse, STS, Gradle, Maven, Jenkins, Sonar, App Dynamics, and Nexus 
Operating Systems: Linux, Windows and Mac OSx 
Methodologies: Agile, Waterfall

positions.title: Software Developer - Associate Consultant
positions.description:
•	Worked on Discover Card Member Posting and Billing Project to modernize their legacy application 
•	Extensive hands-on experience in Microservices development using spring boot and deployment in Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) 
•	Integrated Swagger UI to generate REST service templates 
•	Good working knowledge in TDD/BDD using Junits/Mockito and Cucumber framework 
•	Used spring config server to externalize application configuration. Used Jenkins for Microservices deployment 
•	Developed Jenkins build and deployment pipeline using GitHub, Jenkins, Artifactory and Pivotal Cloud which automates build/deployment process and eliminates manual work. Also used Sonar for code quality analyzer 
•	Introduce blue/green deployment techniques to mitigate deployment incidents

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
•	Designing and developing ICR-web application, an application that uses cognitive and cloud technology to empower individuals to make superior decision 
•	Developed working prototype from ideas on notes - a cognitive science web app named Intellectual Capital Repository® for enhanced decision making process 
•	Created in-house MVC framework for the web app using JAVA, JSP, Servlets, Java Beans, MySQL JDBC, HTML, CSS, JSTL 
•	Responsible to update existing database and integrate it to new designed modules. Also created stored procedures +functions

educations.schoolName: L.J. Institute Of Engineering and Technology

projects.title: Plate of Fire
projects.description:
Developed GUI base  fighting game(Batman, Superman, Spiderman etc) which gives an exciting experience to make fight between two same level players with different rules and customization that allows game player to gain their power(weapon, special moves, vehicles etc) level as well as experience level by winning game.  

Project is developed using java, swing and Object oriented design pattern.
I have implemented following design patterns:

Abstract Factory Pattern, Singleton Pattern, Fly-Weight Pattern, Strategy Pattern, Decorator Pattern, State Pattern.

projects.title: Amazon EC2 Benchmarking
projects.description:
CPU, Disk, Network Benchmarking (Amazon AWS EC2)

Calculated the processor speed in terms of Giga FLOPS and Giga IOPS with varying concurrency levels (1, 2 and 4 threads)

Measured disk throughput and latency for sequential and random read-write with varying block sizes and concurrency levels (1 and 2 threads)

Checked network speed between two Amazon EC2 instances using TCP and UDP with varying block sizes and concurrency levels (1, 2 threads)

Compared results of CPU, Disk and network with standard benchmarking tools available: LINPACK, Iozone and iPerf
